note: Shared code (ADR 0013, ADR 0001 §5 D18): what a bundle built with it holds. Each case builds a whole sync folder with shared_code and checks each script's record (its group's closure, by a case-local label: one label is one closure, two labels two; a fallback with its reason; or none), what each closure holds, and, for t-closure-membership, that the per-script bundles are the same bytes as without shared code. What a script sees at run time is conformance/steps/bun/d18.yaml's.

cases.title: a group's dependency modules are in its closure once, the scripts' own entries and the host-provided modules are not, and the per-script bundles stay the same bytes
cases.note: The host-provided module's file loads as its shim, under its own path (milestone F3h), so the closure names the path but holds the shim, which reads the registry, not the module's text. It also holds D18/w and D18/x: the folder is built again without shared code, every per-script module is the same bytes, and the manifest's digest differs; the manifest records shared_code, lists the closure and D18.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
includes:
  - f/**
excludes:
  - f/cb/lib/**
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes:
      - f/cb/**
folder.f/cb/lib/dep.ts:
import { ctx } from "../../host/ctx";
export function dep() { return ctx.tag; }

given.contract:
roots:
  - script: f/cb/a
  - script: f/cb/b
host_modules: [f/host/ctx.ts]

cases.title: a script keeps its per-script bundle where one closure cannot serve it, with the reason, and the others of its group keep their shared layout
cases.note: The reasons: a banner on its entry, an object or array define value, top-level await in a dependency (an ES module group, since a CommonJS bundle cannot hold it either), a static import of an external module from a dependency in an ES module group (a Node builtin is not one), a kept import() in a dependency, and a cycle through its own entry. Each such script gets the shared_code_fallback warning.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
includes:
  - f/**
excludes:
  - f/y3/lib/**
  - f/y4/lib/**
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/y1
    includes:
      - f/y1/**
    banner:
      js: '// a banner'
  - relative_path: f/y2
    includes:
      - f/y2/**
    define:
      WL_OBJ: '{"a": 1}'
  - relative_path: f/y3
    includes:
      - f/y3/**
  - relative_path: f/y4
    includes:
      - f/y4/**
    format: esm
    external: [y-external]
folder.f/y3/lib/back.ts:
import { name } from "../cyc";
export function back() { return name; }
folder.f/y3/dyn.ts:
import { load } from "./lib/load";
export function main(spec: string) { return load(spec); }
folder.f/y3/lib/load.ts: export function load(spec: string) { return import(spec); }
folder.f/y3/ok.ts:
import { fine } from "./lib/fine";
export function main() { return fine; }
folder.f/y3/lib/fine.ts:
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
export const fine = typeof readFileSync;
folder.f/y4/tla.ts:
import { later } from "./lib/later";
export function main() { return later; }
folder.f/y4/ext.ts:
import { ext } from "./lib/ext";
export function main() { return ext; }
folder.f/y4/lib/ext.ts:
import { thing } from "y-external";
export const ext = thing;
folder.f/y4/lib/fine.ts:
import { join } from "node:path";
export const fine = typeof join;

given.contract:
roots:
  - script: f/y1/a
  - script: f/y2/a
  - script: f/y3/cyc
  - script: f/y3/dyn
  - script: f/y3/ok
  - script: f/y4/tla
  - script: f/y4/ext
  - script: f/y4/ok
